title: EMS PCS Communication Configuration
description: Modbus connection and register map configuration for the Power Conversion System (PCS). Supports both Modbus RTU (RS485) and Modbus TCP. The if/then conditional enforces protocol-specific required fields.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

register_map_path.description: Path to the PCS Modbus register map YAML file. Contains all register addresses, scaling, and metadata.

connection.description: Modbus transport layer configuration. Protocol selects RTU (RS485 serial) or TCP (Ethernet).

protocol.description: Modbus transport protocol. 'rtu' uses RS485 serial, 'tcp' uses Ethernet.

slave_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the PCS device.

device.description: Serial device path for Modbus RTU. Example: /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/ttyS1.

baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for Modbus RTU. Must match PCS hardware configuration. Default: 9600.

parity.description: Serial parity for Modbus RTU. N=None, E=Even, O=Odd. Default: N.

stopbits.description: Number of serial stop bits for Modbus RTU. Default: 1.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the PCS device for Modbus TCP.

port.description: TCP port number for Modbus TCP. Standard Modbus TCP port is 502.

registers.description: Modbus register addresses for PCS control and monitoring. Values are decimal register numbers from the PCS V1.24 register map.

power_setpoint.description: Modbus register for active power setpoint command. PCS V1.24: 0x500E (20494 decimal). Write in kW * 10.

on_off_control.description: Modbus register for PCS on/off control command. PCS V1.24: 0x0291 (657 decimal). Write 1=on, 0=off.

voltage_read.description: Modbus register for AC voltage readback (RMS). Scaling per PCS V1.24 register map.

current_read.description: Modbus register for AC current readback (RMS). Scaling per PCS V1.24 register map.

frequency_read.description: Modbus register for AC frequency readback. Scaling per PCS V1.24 register map.

timing.description: Modbus polling interval, timeout, and retry configuration.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll PCS registers. Shorter intervals improve control responsiveness but increase bus load.

timeout_ms.description: Modbus request timeout. If no response within this window, the request is retried or a fault is raised.

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry a failed Modbus request before declaring a communication fault.

fault_injection.description: Optional fault injection settings for Modbus PCS simulator testing. When present, the simulator applies configured faults to emulate degraded PCS behavior.

response_timeout.description: Simulator stops responding for a configurable duration at startup.

timeout_duration_s.description: How long (seconds) the simulator remains unresponsive when response_timeout is true. Default 10.0.

exception_code.description: Modbus exception code to return for configured registers. 1=illegal function, 2=illegal address, 3=illegal value, 4=slave failure.

exception_registers.description: Register addresses that return Modbus exceptions instead of normal values.

signal_tuning.description: Optional signal tuning overrides for Modbus PCS simulator telemetry generation.

ramp_rate_pct_per_s.description: Telemetry ramp rate override in percent per second.

startup_delay_s.description: Delay before telemetry values start updating after server start.

voltage_noise.description: Gaussian noise amplitude added to voltage readings.
